lessons.title: Greetings
lessons.setting: 你早上在社区咖啡馆遇到邻居。
lessons.opening: Morning! Nice to see you.
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样自然回应问候？
lessons.natural: Good morning! How are you?
lessons.alternative: Morning! How’s it going?
lessons.awkward: Good morning! How do you do today?
lessons.response: I’m good, thanks. It’s a lovely morning.
lessons.tip: 日常问候可用 How are you? 或更口语的 How’s it going?。

lessons.title: Making introductions
lessons.setting: 朋友把你介绍给一位新同事。
lessons.opening: Hi, I’m Jamie. I work with Alex.
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样介绍自己？
lessons.natural: Nice to meet you. I’m Lin.
lessons.alternative: Hi, I’m Lin. It’s great to meet you.
lessons.awkward: Nice meet you. My name Lin.
lessons.response: Nice to meet you too, Lin.
lessons.tip: Nice to meet you 后接完整的 I’m...。

lessons.title: Conversation fillers
lessons.setting: 朋友讲故事时短暂停下来思考。
lessons.opening: It happened a few years ago... let me think.
lessons.prompt: 你想自然表示自己正在听，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Right, I see.
lessons.alternative: Uh-huh, go on.
lessons.awkward: Yes, I am listening you.
lessons.response: So anyway, we finally found the place.
lessons.tip: Right、I see、Uh-huh 都能自然维持对话。

lessons.title: Saying you don’t understand
lessons.setting: 同事快速解释了一个新流程，但你没有听懂。
lessons.opening: Then you submit it through the internal portal.
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样礼貌地请对方再解释一次？
lessons.natural: Sorry, I didn’t quite understand that.
lessons.alternative: Could you explain that again, please?
lessons.awkward: I don’t understand what you sayed.
lessons.response: Of course. I’ll show you step by step.
lessons.tip: didn’t quite understand 比直接否定更委婉。

lessons.title: Opinions and preferences
lessons.setting: 朋友问你周末想看动作片还是喜剧片。
lessons.opening: Would you rather see an action film or a comedy?
lessons.prompt: 你更想看喜剧片，会怎么回答？
lessons.natural: I’d prefer to see a comedy.
lessons.alternative: I’d rather watch a comedy.
lessons.awkward: I more like to see a comedy.
lessons.response: Great, there’s a new comedy showing tonight.
lessons.tip: 表达偏好可用 would prefer to 或 would rather。

lessons.title: Agreeing and disagreeing
lessons.setting: 朋友说这家咖啡馆是附近最好的一家。
lessons.opening: I think this is the best café in the neighbourhood.
lessons.prompt: 你基本同意，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I agree. The coffee here is excellent.
lessons.alternative: I think you’re right.
lessons.awkward: I am agree with you.
lessons.response: And the staff are always friendly too.
lessons.tip: agree 是动词，应说 I agree。

lessons.title: Making suggestions
lessons.setting: 你和朋友还没决定周日下午做什么。
lessons.opening: We haven’t planned anything for Sunday afternoon.
lessons.prompt: 你想建议去公园走走，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Why don’t we go for a walk in the park?
lessons.alternative: How about going for a walk in the park?
lessons.awkward: Why we don’t go walking in park?
lessons.response: That sounds relaxing. Let’s do that.
lessons.tip: 建议可用 Why don’t we...? 或 How about doing...?。

lessons.title: Saying thank you
lessons.setting: 同事主动帮你完成了一项紧急任务。
lessons.opening: I’ve finished checking those figures for you.
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样真诚道谢？
lessons.natural: Thank you so much for your help.
lessons.alternative: I really appreciate it.
lessons.awkward: I very thank you for helping.
lessons.response: You’re welcome. I’m glad I could help.
lessons.tip: appreciate 后接 it 或具体事物。

lessons.title: Saying sorry
lessons.setting: 你不小心撞到了排队的人。
lessons.opening: Oh!
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样立即道歉？
lessons.natural: I’m so sorry. Are you okay?
lessons.alternative: Sorry about that.
lessons.awkward: I very apologize you.
lessons.response: I’m fine, don’t worry.
lessons.tip: 轻微意外可用 I’m so sorry 或 Sorry about that。

lessons.title: Saying goodbye
lessons.setting: 拜访朋友后，你准备回家。
lessons.opening: It’s getting late.
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样自然告别？
lessons.natural: I’d better get going. See you soon.
lessons.alternative: Thanks for having me. See you later.
lessons.awkward: I go now. Goodbye you.
lessons.response: Thanks for coming. Get home safely.
lessons.tip: I’d better get going 是自然的离开表达。

lessons.title: Dates, time, and weather
lessons.setting: 朋友想确认活动的日期和时间。
lessons.opening: When is the outdoor concert?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样说明周六下午三点？
lessons.natural: It’s at three o’clock on Saturday afternoon.
lessons.alternative: It starts at three this Saturday.
lessons.awkward: It is in Saturday at three afternoon.
lessons.response: Perfect. I’ll put it in my calendar.
lessons.tip: 时间用 at，星期与日期用 on。

lessons.title: Making arrangements
lessons.setting: 你和朋友准备约时间见面。
lessons.opening: When are you free this week?
lessons.prompt: 你想约周四晚上，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Are you free on Thursday evening?
lessons.alternative: How about Thursday evening?
lessons.awkward: Are you free in Thursday night?
lessons.response: Thursday evening works for me.
lessons.tip: 具体星期前用 on。

lessons.title: Talking about the weather
lessons.setting: 你和同事走出办公楼，外面突然变冷。
lessons.opening: It’s much colder than yesterday.
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样接着聊天？
lessons.natural: Yes, it looks like it might rain too.
lessons.alternative: I know. I should have brought a jacket.
lessons.awkward: Yes, the weather is doing cold.
lessons.response: Let’s get inside before it starts raining.
lessons.tip: 天气变化可用 it looks like... 或 it’s getting...。

lessons.title: Family and relationships
lessons.setting: 新朋友问你周末通常和谁一起度过。
lessons.opening: Who do you usually spend weekends with?
lessons.prompt: 你想说通常和家人一起，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I usually spend weekends with my family.
lessons.alternative: Most weekends, I’m with my family.
lessons.awkward: I usually pass weekends with my families.
lessons.response: That sounds nice. Are they nearby?
lessons.tip: spend weekends with 是固定搭配。

lessons.title: Life events
lessons.setting: 朋友告诉你她下个月要搬到新城市。
lessons.opening: I’m moving to Bristol next month.
lessons.prompt: 你想表达祝贺并询问感受，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: That’s exciting! How do you feel about it?
lessons.alternative: Congratulations! Are you looking forward to it?
lessons.awkward: That is excite! How are you feeling it?
lessons.response: I’m excited, but a little nervous too.
lessons.tip: exciting 描述事情，excited 描述人的感受。

lessons.title: Socializing
lessons.setting: 你刚到朋友聚会，主人请你认识其他客人。
lessons.opening: Come in! Let me introduce you to everyone.
lessons.prompt: 你想友好回应，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Thanks. I’d love to meet everyone.
lessons.alternative: Great, thanks for inviting me.
lessons.awkward: Thanks. I love meet all persons.
lessons.response: Everyone’s in the living room.
lessons.tip: would love to 后接动词原形。

lessons.title: Dating and romance
lessons.setting: 朋友问你第一次约会想去哪里。
lessons.opening: Where would you like to go for your first date?
lessons.prompt: 你想建议安静的咖啡馆，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’d like to go somewhere quiet, maybe a café.
lessons.alternative: A quiet café would be nice.
lessons.awkward: I want go some quiet café.
lessons.response: That sounds perfect for getting to know each other.
lessons.tip: would like to 比 want 更柔和。

lessons.title: Showing support
lessons.setting: 朋友说最近工作压力很大。
lessons.opening: Work has been really stressful lately.
lessons.prompt: 你想表示支持，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’m sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about it?
lessons.alternative: I’m here if you need me.
lessons.awkward: Do not stress. It is nothing.
lessons.response: Thanks. I could really use someone to talk to.
lessons.tip: 先承认对方感受，再询问是否愿意聊。

lessons.title: Eating and drinking
lessons.setting: 朋友问你平时喜欢吃什么。
lessons.opening: What kind of food do you like?
lessons.prompt: 你想说喜欢尝试不同菜系，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I enjoy trying food from different countries.
lessons.alternative: I like all kinds of food.
lessons.awkward: I enjoy to try different country foods.
lessons.response: Me too. I especially like Thai food.
lessons.tip: enjoy 后接动名词 trying。

lessons.title: Cafés and coffee shops
lessons.setting: 你在咖啡馆柜台准备点饮料。
lessons.opening: Hi! What can I get for you?
lessons.prompt: 你想点一杯燕麦奶拿铁，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Could I have a latte with oat milk, please?
lessons.alternative: I’d like an oat milk latte, please.
lessons.awkward: Give me one latte of oat milk.
lessons.response: Of course. Would you like it hot or iced?
lessons.tip: 点单使用 Could I have...? 或 I’d like... 更礼貌。

lessons.title: Takeaway and delivery
lessons.setting: 你打电话询问外卖订单。
lessons.opening: Green Garden Takeaway. How can I help?
lessons.prompt: 你想问是否可以送餐，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Do you deliver to King Street?
lessons.alternative: Can I get this delivered to King Street?
lessons.awkward: Can you delivery food in King Street?
lessons.response: Yes, we deliver there for a small fee.
lessons.tip: deliver 是动词；地址前使用 to。

lessons.title: Bars and pubs
lessons.setting: 你和朋友在酒吧，准备点不含酒精的饮料。
lessons.opening: What can I get you?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样点单？
lessons.natural: Could I have something non-alcoholic, please?
lessons.alternative: I’ll have a sparkling water, please.
lessons.awkward: Give me a drink without alcohols.
lessons.response: Sure. We have several alcohol-free options.
lessons.tip: non-alcoholic 或 alcohol-free 均可。

lessons.title: At the restaurant
lessons.setting: 服务员来到桌边询问是否可以点餐。
lessons.opening: Are you ready to order?
lessons.prompt: 你还需要几分钟，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Could we have a few more minutes, please?
lessons.alternative: We’re not quite ready yet.
lessons.awkward: We need more minutes for order.
lessons.response: Of course. I’ll come back shortly.
lessons.tip: a few more minutes 是自然表达。

lessons.title: Cooking and eating
lessons.setting: 你和朋友一起做晚饭，对方问需要帮什么。
lessons.opening: What can I do to help?
lessons.prompt: 你想请对方切洋葱，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Could you chop the onions, please?
lessons.alternative: Can you cut up the onions?
lessons.awkward: Can you make the onions small?
lessons.response: Sure. Where’s the chopping board?
lessons.tip: chop 或 cut up 都可表示切碎。

lessons.title: Free time and hobbies
lessons.setting: 新朋友问你空闲时间喜欢做什么。
lessons.opening: What do you like doing in your free time?
lessons.prompt: 你想说喜欢徒步和摄影，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I enjoy hiking and taking photos.
lessons.alternative: I like to go hiking and do photography.
lessons.awkward: I enjoy hike and take photo.
lessons.response: That sounds fun. Where do you usually hike?
lessons.tip: enjoy 后接动名词。

lessons.title: At the cinema
lessons.setting: 你在电影院售票处买票。
lessons.opening: Which film would you like to see?
lessons.prompt: 你想买两张七点场的票，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Two tickets for the seven o’clock showing, please.
lessons.alternative: Could I have two tickets for the film at seven?
lessons.awkward: I want two ticket of seven clock.
lessons.response: Certainly. Would you like seats near the back?
lessons.tip: 场次可说 the seven o’clock showing。

lessons.title: At the theatre
lessons.setting: 演出开始前，你向工作人员寻找座位。
lessons.opening: Can I help you find your seat?
lessons.prompt: 你想说明座位信息，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Yes, I’m in row G, seat 12.
lessons.alternative: Yes, could you show me where row G is?
lessons.awkward: My place is line G number 12.
lessons.response: This way, please. Your seat is on the left.
lessons.tip: 剧院座位用 row 和 seat。

lessons.title: Concerts and festivals
lessons.setting: 朋友问你要不要一起参加音乐节。
lessons.opening: Would you like to come to the music festival with us?
lessons.prompt: 你很想去，会怎么回答？
lessons.natural: I’d love to. When does it start?
lessons.alternative: That sounds great. Count me in.
lessons.awkward: I very want to come there.
lessons.response: It starts at noon on Saturday.
lessons.tip: I’d love to 是热情接受邀请的自然表达。

lessons.title: At the gym
lessons.setting: 你第一次到健身房，想请教练介绍器械。
lessons.opening: Is this your first time here?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样请求帮助？
lessons.natural: Yes. Could you show me how to use this machine?
lessons.alternative: Yes, I’d like some help getting started.
lessons.awkward: Yes. Show me how use this machine.
lessons.response: Absolutely. Let’s adjust it for you first.
lessons.tip: show someone how to do something。

lessons.title: Sporting activities
lessons.setting: 朋友邀请你周末一起打网球。
lessons.opening: Do you fancy playing tennis on Saturday?
lessons.prompt: 你想接受但说明水平一般，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Sure, but I’m not very good at it.
lessons.alternative: I’d love to, although I’m a beginner.
lessons.awkward: Yes, but I play not very well it.
lessons.response: No problem. We’ll just play for fun.
lessons.tip: be good at 后接名词或动名词。

lessons.title: Sports events
lessons.setting: 你和朋友准备去看足球比赛。
lessons.opening: Have you got the tickets?
lessons.prompt: 你想说票在手机里，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Yes, I’ve got them on my phone.
lessons.alternative: Yes, the tickets are saved on my phone.
lessons.awkward: Yes, I have it inside my telephone.
lessons.response: Great. Let’s head to the entrance.
lessons.tip: 复数 tickets 用 them。

lessons.title: Hobbies
lessons.setting: 同事注意到你桌上的手工作品。
lessons.opening: Did you make that yourself?
lessons.prompt: 你想介绍自己的手工爱好，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Yes, making pottery is one of my hobbies.
lessons.alternative: Yes, I do pottery in my spare time.
lessons.awkward: Yes, I make potteries for hobby.
lessons.response: It looks fantastic. How long have you been doing it?
lessons.tip: pottery 通常不可数。

lessons.title: Shops and services
lessons.setting: 你在购物中心寻找可以修手机的地方。
lessons.opening: How can I help you?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样询问维修店位置？
lessons.natural: Is there anywhere here that repairs phones?
lessons.alternative: Where can I get my phone repaired?
lessons.awkward: Where is a shop repair my phone?
lessons.response: There’s a repair shop on the second floor.
lessons.tip: get something repaired 表示请人维修。

lessons.title: At the market
lessons.setting: 你在市场摊位前询问水果价格。
lessons.opening: These strawberries are fresh this morning.
lessons.prompt: 你想问一盒多少钱，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: How much is a box of strawberries?
lessons.alternative: How much are the strawberries per box?
lessons.awkward: How many money is one strawberries box?
lessons.response: They’re four pounds a box.
lessons.tip: 询问价格用 How much...?。

lessons.title: At the supermarket
lessons.setting: 你在超市找不到燕麦奶。
lessons.opening: Can I help you find something?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样询问位置？
lessons.natural: Excuse me, where can I find the oat milk?
lessons.alternative: Which aisle is the oat milk in?
lessons.awkward: Where the oat milk is finding?
lessons.response: It’s in aisle six, next to the dairy-free products.
lessons.tip: 可用 Where can I find...? 或 Which aisle...?。

lessons.title: At the garden centre
lessons.setting: 你想买适合室内弱光环境的植物。
lessons.opening: Are you looking for anything in particular?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样说明需求？
lessons.natural: I’m looking for a plant that doesn’t need much light.
lessons.alternative: Could you recommend a low-light houseplant?
lessons.awkward: I want plant no need many lights.
lessons.response: A snake plant would be a good choice.
lessons.tip: look for 表示寻找。

lessons.title: At the DIY store
lessons.setting: 你想把画挂到墙上，但不知道该买什么。
lessons.opening: What are you working on?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样请求建议？
lessons.natural: What do I need to hang a picture on the wall?
lessons.alternative: Could you help me choose the right hooks?
lessons.awkward: What thing I need for put picture in wall?
lessons.response: These hooks should work for that type of wall.
lessons.tip: need to do 与 help me choose 结构自然。

lessons.title: Buying clothes and shoes
lessons.setting: 你试穿一件夹克，但尺寸太小。
lessons.opening: How does the jacket fit?
lessons.prompt: 你想换大一码，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: It’s a little tight. Do you have a larger size?
lessons.alternative: Could I try this in the next size up?
lessons.awkward: It is small. Give me more big size.
lessons.response: Certainly. I’ll bring you a larger one.
lessons.tip: 衣服紧用 tight；大一码可说 next size up。

lessons.title: Returning goods
lessons.setting: 你带着有故障的台灯回到商店。
lessons.opening: What seems to be the problem?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样说明退货原因？
lessons.natural: I’d like to return this lamp because it doesn’t work.
lessons.alternative: This lamp is faulty. Could I get a refund?
lessons.awkward: I want return it because it no works.
lessons.response: I’m sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?
lessons.tip: return 与 get a refund 是退货常用表达。

lessons.title: Hair, beauty, and grooming
lessons.setting: 你到理发店准备剪头发。
lessons.opening: What would you like today?
lessons.prompt: 你想稍微剪短但保留长度，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Just a trim, please. I’d like to keep most of the length.
lessons.alternative: Could you take a little off the ends?
lessons.awkward: Cut short but not too much hairs.
lessons.response: Of course. I’ll just tidy up the ends.
lessons.tip: just a trim 表示只稍微修剪。

lessons.title: Sending and receiving
lessons.setting: 你在邮局寄一个易碎包裹。
lessons.opening: Where are you sending the parcel?
lessons.prompt: 你想寄到国外并说明易碎，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’d like to send this abroad. It’s fragile.
lessons.alternative: Could I send this parcel internationally?
lessons.awkward: I want send this outside country. It breaks easy.
lessons.response: Certainly. We’ll add a fragile label.
lessons.tip: abroad 表示往国外；fragile 表示易碎。

lessons.title: Money and finance
lessons.setting: 你在银行询问银行卡上的陌生扣款。
lessons.opening: How can I help you today?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样说明问题？
lessons.natural: I don’t recognize this charge on my card.
lessons.alternative: Could you help me check this card payment?
lessons.awkward: I do not know this money taking.
lessons.response: Let me look into that transaction for you.
lessons.tip: charge 或 transaction 可表示一笔交易。

lessons.title: At the library
lessons.setting: 你到图书馆寻找一本已借出的书。
lessons.opening: Have you found what you’re looking for?
lessons.prompt: 你想询问是否可以预约，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Could I reserve this book when it’s returned?
lessons.alternative: Can you put this book on hold for me?
lessons.awkward: Can I reservation this book after return?
lessons.response: Yes, I’ll notify you when it’s available.
lessons.tip: reserve 或 put on hold 都表示预约图书。

lessons.title: Work and study
lessons.setting: 新朋友问你现在是工作还是学习。
lessons.opening: What do you do?
lessons.prompt: 你想说一边工作一边上夜校，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I work full-time and study in the evenings.
lessons.alternative: I’m working while taking an evening course.
lessons.awkward: I am work and study in nights.
lessons.response: That sounds busy. What are you studying?
lessons.tip: work full-time 与 study in the evenings 是自然搭配。

lessons.title: At school
lessons.setting: 你是新生，找不到科学教室。
lessons.opening: Are you looking for your classroom?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样询问位置？
lessons.natural: Yes. Could you tell me where the science room is?
lessons.alternative: Yes, which way is the science classroom?
lessons.awkward: Yes. Where is being science class?
lessons.response: It’s upstairs, opposite the library.
lessons.tip: Could you tell me where... 使用陈述语序。

lessons.title: Further and higher education
lessons.setting: 你在大学开放日咨询课程。
lessons.opening: What subject are you interested in?
lessons.prompt: 你想询问计算机课程入学要求，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: What are the entry requirements for computer science?
lessons.alternative: What qualifications do I need for this course?
lessons.awkward: What requests need enter computer science?
lessons.response: You’ll need to meet the grades listed here.
lessons.tip: entry requirements 是入学要求。

lessons.title: Looking for work
lessons.setting: 朋友问你正在寻找什么样的工作。
lessons.opening: What kind of job are you looking for?
lessons.prompt: 你想说寻找客户服务职位，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’m looking for a job in customer service.
lessons.alternative: I’d like to work in customer service.
lessons.awkward: I am searching a customer service work.
lessons.response: I saw a vacancy that might suit you.
lessons.tip: look for a job in... 是自然表达。

lessons.title: Applying for a job
lessons.setting: 你准备提交申请，想确认截止时间。
lessons.opening: Do you have any questions about the application?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样询问截止日期？
lessons.natural: When is the application deadline?
lessons.alternative: What’s the deadline for applying?
lessons.awkward: When the application must finish?
lessons.response: Applications close at five on Friday.
lessons.tip: application deadline 是申请截止日期。

lessons.title: Job interviews
lessons.setting: 面试官请你介绍自己的优势。
lessons.opening: What would you say is one of your strengths?
lessons.prompt: 你想说自己善于团队合作，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I work well in a team and communicate clearly.
lessons.alternative: One of my strengths is teamwork.
lessons.awkward: My strong is I can team work good.
lessons.response: Can you give me an example of that?
lessons.tip: one of my strengths is... 是清楚句型。

lessons.title: Starting a new job
lessons.setting: 入职第一天，同事主动向你提供帮助。
lessons.opening: Let me know if you need help finding anything.
lessons.prompt: 你想询问午休时间，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Thanks. What time do people usually take lunch?
lessons.alternative: Thanks. When is the lunch break?
lessons.awkward: Thanks. What hour people eat lunch?
lessons.response: Most of us go around twelve thirty.
lessons.tip: 询问惯例可用 What time do people usually...?。

lessons.title: In the workplace
lessons.setting: 你需要下班前完成报告，想请同事协助。
lessons.opening: You look busy. Is everything okay?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样礼貌请求帮助？
lessons.natural: Could you help me check this report before the end of the day?
lessons.alternative: Would you mind looking over this report?
lessons.awkward: Can you helping me check report before work end?
lessons.response: Sure. Send it to me and I’ll take a look.
lessons.tip: Could you help me 后接动词原形。

lessons.title: The home
lessons.setting: 朋友第一次到你家，称赞客厅舒适。
lessons.opening: Your living room is really cosy.
lessons.prompt: 你想介绍最喜欢的角落，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Thanks. This reading corner is my favourite part of the house.
lessons.alternative: Thank you. I spend a lot of time reading here.
lessons.awkward: Thanks. This is my most favourite house part.
lessons.response: I can see why. It gets lots of natural light.
lessons.tip: favourite 已含最高程度，不与 most 连用。

lessons.title: Finding a new home
lessons.setting: 你和房产中介看一套公寓。
lessons.opening: What do you think of the flat?
lessons.prompt: 你想询问房租是否包含水电费，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Are the bills included in the rent?
lessons.alternative: Does the rent include utilities?
lessons.awkward: The bills are including inside rent?
lessons.response: Water is included, but electricity isn’t.
lessons.tip: be included in 与 include utilities 均可。

lessons.title: Moving house
lessons.setting: 朋友来帮你搬家，看到许多纸箱。
lessons.opening: Where should I put these boxes?
lessons.prompt: 你想请他放到卧室，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Could you put them in the bedroom, please?
lessons.alternative: They can go in the bedroom, thanks.
lessons.awkward: Please put it to bedroom.
lessons.response: No problem. I’ll take them upstairs.
lessons.tip: 复数 boxes 用 them；房间内部用 in。

lessons.title: Meeting the neighbours
lessons.setting: 你刚搬来，第一次在门口遇到邻居。
lessons.opening: Hi, I don’t think we’ve met.
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样介绍自己？
lessons.natural: Hi, I’m Lin. I’ve just moved in next door.
lessons.alternative: Nice to meet you. I’m your new neighbour.
lessons.awkward: Hello, I am new moving beside you.
lessons.response: Welcome to the neighbourhood!
lessons.tip: move in 表示搬入；next door 表示隔壁。

lessons.title: Household chores
lessons.setting: 你和室友商量家务分工。
lessons.opening: The kitchen needs cleaning.
lessons.prompt: 你想主动洗碗，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’ll do the washing-up if you clean the floor.
lessons.alternative: I can wash the dishes. Could you mop the floor?
lessons.awkward: I make dishes clean and you make floor.
lessons.response: That sounds fair.
lessons.tip: do the washing-up 或 wash the dishes 表示洗碗。

lessons.title: Home improvements
lessons.setting: 你想重新粉刷客厅，正和朋友讨论颜色。
lessons.opening: Have you decided what colour to paint it?
lessons.prompt: 你考虑浅绿色，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’m thinking of painting it light green.
lessons.alternative: Maybe we could use a pale green.
lessons.awkward: I think to paint it with light green colour.
lessons.response: That would make the room feel fresh and bright.
lessons.tip: think of 后接动名词。

lessons.title: Pets
lessons.setting: 你在公园遇到朋友和他的新狗。
lessons.opening: This is Milo. We adopted him last week.
lessons.prompt: 你想询问狗的品种，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: He’s lovely. What breed is he?
lessons.alternative: What kind of dog is he?
lessons.awkward: What race of dog is it?
lessons.response: He’s a rescue, probably a terrier mix.
lessons.tip: 询问宠物品种使用 breed 或 kind。

lessons.title: Home emergencies
lessons.setting: 家里水管漏水，你给房东打电话。
lessons.opening: Hello, is everything all right?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样说明紧急情况？
lessons.natural: There’s a leak under the kitchen sink.
lessons.alternative: The pipe under the sink is leaking.
lessons.awkward: The water pipe is losing water under kitchen.
lessons.response: I’ll send a plumber over right away.
lessons.tip: leak 是名词，be leaking 是动词表达。

lessons.title: Home entertainment
lessons.setting: 朋友来你家，你们准备看电影。
lessons.opening: What shall we watch?
lessons.prompt: 你想让对方选择，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: You choose. I’m happy to watch anything.
lessons.alternative: I don’t mind. What are you in the mood for?
lessons.awkward: You decide because everything is same for me.
lessons.response: How about that new mystery film?
lessons.tip: I don’t mind 表示没有特别偏好。

lessons.title: Getting around
lessons.setting: 你刚到陌生城市，向工作人员询问交通。
lessons.opening: Where are you trying to get to?
lessons.prompt: 你想去市中心，会怎么询问？
lessons.natural: What’s the best way to get to the city centre?
lessons.alternative: How can I get to the city centre from here?
lessons.awkward: Which is best road going city centre?
lessons.response: The tram is quickest at this time of day.
lessons.tip: the best way to get to... 是自然句型。

lessons.title: Buses and coaches
lessons.setting: 你在公交站想确认公交是否到火车站。
lessons.opening: Are you waiting for the number 12?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样确认路线？
lessons.natural: Does this bus go to the train station?
lessons.alternative: Can I take this bus to the train station?
lessons.awkward: Is this bus going at train station?
lessons.response: Yes, but you’ll need to get off at the next stop.
lessons.tip: 询问固定路线用 Does this bus go to...?。

lessons.title: Train and metro travel
lessons.setting: 你在地铁售票机旁向工作人员求助。
lessons.opening: Do you need any help with the machine?
lessons.prompt: 你想买去中央车站的单程票，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Yes, I need a single ticket to Central Station.
lessons.alternative: Could you help me buy a one-way ticket to Central Station?
lessons.awkward: I need one ticket only go Central Station.
lessons.response: Of course. Select “single” on this screen.
lessons.tip: single ticket 与 one-way ticket 都表示单程票。

lessons.title: At the airport
lessons.setting: 你到机场值机柜台准备办理手续。
lessons.opening: Good morning. May I see your passport?
lessons.prompt: 你递上护照并想托运行李，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Of course. I’d also like to check in this bag.
lessons.alternative: Here you are. Can I check this bag?
lessons.awkward: Take passport. I want send this bag.
lessons.response: Certainly. Please place it on the scale.
lessons.tip: check in a bag 表示办理托运。

lessons.title: Cycling
lessons.setting: 你准备租自行车游览城市。
lessons.opening: What kind of bike are you looking for?
lessons.prompt: 你想租一辆一天，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’d like to rent a bike for the day.
lessons.alternative: Can I hire a bike for one day?
lessons.awkward: I want borrow bike during one day.
lessons.response: Sure. Would you like a helmet as well?
lessons.tip: rent/hire 表示付费租用。

lessons.title: Taxis
lessons.setting: 你坐进出租车，需要去一个地址。
lessons.opening: Where would you like to go?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样告诉司机目的地？
lessons.natural: Could you take me to this address, please?
lessons.alternative: I’d like to go to 25 King Street, please.
lessons.awkward: Bring me at this address.
lessons.response: No problem. It should take about twenty minutes.
lessons.tip: Could you take me to...? 礼貌自然。

lessons.title: At the garage
lessons.setting: 汽车发出异响，你把车开到修理厂。
lessons.opening: What seems to be the problem?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样描述问题？
lessons.natural: The car makes a strange noise when I brake.
lessons.alternative: There’s an unusual sound when I use the brakes.
lessons.awkward: My car has strange voice when I stop it.
lessons.response: I’ll take a look at the brakes first.
lessons.tip: 汽车发出声音用 make a noise/sound。

lessons.title: On holiday
lessons.setting: 你在酒店早餐区与另一位旅客聊天。
lessons.opening: Are you here on holiday?
lessons.prompt: 你想说第一次来这里度假，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Yes, it’s my first time here.
lessons.alternative: Yes, I’m here for a week’s holiday.
lessons.awkward: Yes, I make holiday here first time.
lessons.response: You’ll love it. There’s plenty to see.
lessons.tip: be on holiday 与 first time here 是常用表达。

lessons.title: Booking a holiday
lessons.setting: 你在旅行社咨询海边假期。
lessons.opening: What kind of holiday are you looking for?
lessons.prompt: 你想预订六月的一周海滨假期，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’d like to book a week by the sea in June.
lessons.alternative: We’re looking for a beach holiday in June.
lessons.awkward: I want booking one week near sea on June.
lessons.response: I can show you a few packages for those dates.
lessons.tip: would like to book 是礼貌预订表达。

lessons.title: Staying in a hotel
lessons.setting: 你刚入住酒店，想了解早餐安排。
lessons.opening: Is everything all right with your room?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样询问早餐时间？
lessons.natural: Yes, thanks. What time is breakfast served?
lessons.alternative: Could you tell me when breakfast starts?
lessons.awkward: At what hour breakfast is serving?
lessons.response: Breakfast is served from seven until ten.
lessons.tip: 询问服务时间可用 What time is ... served?。

lessons.title: City sightseeing
lessons.setting: 你在游客中心询问半天观光建议。
lessons.opening: How much time do you have in the city?
lessons.prompt: 你只有半天，会怎么询问？
lessons.natural: What would you recommend seeing in half a day?
lessons.alternative: What are the main sights I can visit this morning?
lessons.awkward: What places must I see in one half day time?
lessons.response: The old town and river walk would fit your schedule.
lessons.tip: recommend doing 与 main sights 是常用表达。

lessons.title: Going camping
lessons.setting: 你和朋友在出发前检查露营装备。
lessons.opening: Have we packed everything?
lessons.prompt: 你想确认是否带了手电筒，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: Did we remember to pack a torch?
lessons.alternative: Have we got a flashlight?
lessons.awkward: Did we remembered taking a light machine?
lessons.response: Yes, it’s in the bag with the batteries.
lessons.tip: remember to do；torch 与 flashlight 均可。

lessons.title: At the beach
lessons.setting: 你在海滩服务处想租遮阳伞。
lessons.opening: Can I help you?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样询问租伞？
lessons.natural: Can I rent a beach umbrella here?
lessons.alternative: Do you hire out parasols?
lessons.awkward: Can I borrow one sun umbrella with money?
lessons.response: Yes, they’re available for the whole day.
lessons.tip: rent/hire 表示付费租用。

lessons.title: Finding your way
lessons.setting: 你在陌生城市找不到博物馆。
lessons.opening: You look a little lost.
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样问路？
lessons.natural: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the museum?
lessons.alternative: Is the museum far from here?
lessons.awkward: Please tell me how go museum.
lessons.response: Go straight and turn left at the traffic lights.
lessons.tip: how to get to... 是自然问路结构。

lessons.title: Holiday problems
lessons.setting: 你到航空公司服务台报告行李没有到达。
lessons.opening: How can I help?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样说明行李遗失？
lessons.natural: My luggage hasn’t arrived. Could you help me?
lessons.alternative: I can’t find my suitcase on the carousel.
lessons.awkward: My luggage did not came here.
lessons.response: I’m sorry. Let’s complete a missing baggage report.
lessons.tip: luggage 是不可数名词。

lessons.title: Health and medicine
lessons.setting: 朋友发现你看起来不舒服。
lessons.opening: You don’t look well. Are you okay?
lessons.prompt: 你想说有点头晕，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’m feeling a little dizzy.
lessons.alternative: I don’t feel very well. I’m a bit light-headed.
lessons.awkward: My head is turning around little.
lessons.response: Sit down for a moment. Shall I get some water?
lessons.tip: dizzy/light-headed 都可描述头晕。

lessons.title: At the pharmacy
lessons.setting: 你到药店说明自己的轻微感冒症状。
lessons.opening: What can I help you with?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样描述流鼻涕和喉咙痛？
lessons.natural: I’ve got a runny nose and a sore throat.
lessons.alternative: I have cold symptoms and a sore throat.
lessons.awkward: My nose runs and my throat has pain.
lessons.response: How long have you had these symptoms?
lessons.tip: runny nose 和 sore throat 是常见表达。

lessons.title: Booking an appointment
lessons.setting: 你打电话到诊所预约看医生。
lessons.opening: Good morning, Riverside Clinic.
lessons.prompt: 你想预约明天，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’d like to make an appointment for tomorrow, please.
lessons.alternative: Is there an appointment available tomorrow?
lessons.awkward: I want reserve doctor tomorrow.
lessons.response: Let me check what times are available.
lessons.tip: make an appointment 是固定搭配。

lessons.title: Seeing the doctor
lessons.setting: 医生询问你哪里不舒服。
lessons.opening: What brings you in today?
lessons.prompt: 你想说头痛了两天，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’ve had a headache for two days.
lessons.alternative: I’ve been getting headaches since Tuesday.
lessons.awkward: I have headache since two days.
lessons.response: Have you noticed any other symptoms?
lessons.tip: 持续一段时间用现在完成时加 for。

lessons.title: Injuries and emergencies
lessons.setting: 你看到有人摔倒受伤，需要向工作人员求助。
lessons.opening: What happened?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样请求紧急帮助？
lessons.natural: Someone has fallen and hurt their leg. Please call an ambulance.
lessons.alternative: We need medical help over here.
lessons.awkward: One person fell and broke maybe leg. Call help.
lessons.response: I’m calling emergency services now.
lessons.tip: 紧急情况要清楚说明并避免猜测诊断。

lessons.title: The hospital
lessons.setting: 你到医院服务台询问应该去哪里登记。
lessons.opening: How can I help you?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样询问登记位置？
lessons.natural: Where should I check in for my appointment?
lessons.alternative: Could you tell me where the outpatient desk is?
lessons.awkward: Where I must make register for doctor?
lessons.response: Please check in at the desk on your right.
lessons.tip: 医院登记也可用 check in。

lessons.title: Dental care
lessons.setting: 你打电话给牙科诊所，因为牙痛。
lessons.opening: How can we help you?
lessons.prompt: 你会怎样说明问题并预约？
lessons.natural: I’ve got a bad toothache and I’d like an appointment.
lessons.alternative: Could I see a dentist about a painful tooth?
lessons.awkward: My tooth is very pain and I want dentist time.
lessons.response: We have an appointment available this afternoon.
lessons.tip: toothache 是名词；painful 是形容词。

lessons.title: Mental health support
lessons.setting: 你最近压力很大，决定和可信赖的朋友聊聊。
lessons.opening: You’ve seemed quiet lately. How are you doing?
lessons.prompt: 你想诚实表达需要支持，会怎么说？
lessons.natural: I’ve been feeling overwhelmed lately. Could we talk?
lessons.alternative: I’ve been under a lot of stress and could use some support.
lessons.awkward: My mind is very bad and you must fix me.
lessons.response: Of course. I’m here to listen.
lessons.tip: 用 overwhelmed 或 under stress 表达感受。
